title: Option Chain Information Content Study
status: DRAFT REV-2 -- not locked until committed

experiment_naming.EXP034-A: 58-usable-day exploratory run defined by this preregistration
experiment_naming.EXP034-C: forward-only confirmatory replication, same locked pipeline
experiment_naming.unsuffixed_exp034: the preregistration and codebase shared by both

boundary.rule: EXP034 never modifies, reruns, regenerates or overwrites any EXP033 artifact. Writes only to data/derived/exp034_*, reports/exp034/, docs/preregistrations/exp034_*. Builds its own panel from raw data/option_chain.

inherited_defect_disclosed.verified_semantics: cumulative daily traded volume -- strictly monotonic non-decreasing across all 172 snapshots of 2026-09-11 for the ATM call; zero negative first differences (open_interest by contrast shows 73 negative differences, correctly a level)
inherited_defect_disclosed.exp033_defect: EXP033 E1 volume-spike family z-scored the raw cumulative level while its docstring described a 2-min increment; that statistic is dominated by intraday drift and largely measured 'cumulative volume has grown since the open'
inherited_defect_disclosed.exp033_action: NOT corrected -- EXP033 is frozen and must not be touched
inherited_defect_disclosed.exp034_action: all volume features defined on the FIRST DIFFERENCE of cumulative volume (F01-F03)

sample_reuse.rationale: third experiment against the same 59 days (exp032, exp033, exp034-A); no within-experiment correction can undo program-level snooping
permitted_conclusion_labels: NO EXPLORATORY EVIDENCE OF INCREMENTAL INFORMATION

confirmatory_replication.usable_definition: a day passing the identical per-day data-quality screen defined in data.per_day_quality_screen -- no other definition
confirmatory_replication.scope: forward days only (collected after 2026-09-11), pipeline byte-identical to the EXP034 freeze manifest
confirmatory_replication.precedent: exp032 freeze policy: re-running locked rules on new data is a separate out-of-sample experiment

rejected_alternatives.B_lockbox_12_days: too small to confirm anything; spends irreplaceable data on a powerless test
rejected_alternatives.C_proceed_unacknowledged: contradicts the discipline that downgraded exp012 after SPA

dgp_v1_semantics.timestamp_semantics: one ts stamped BEFORE any network call; all rows of a poll share it
dgp_v1_semantics.quote_to_spot_ordering: quotes fetched first, get_spot() called last, 30s spot cache
dgp_v1_semantics.near_expiry_selection: minimum expiry present in the snapshot
dgp_v1_semantics.spot_source_semantics: live index LTP with daily-close fallback on LTP failure
dgp_v1_semantics.vix_timing_semantics: fetched BEFORE the chains, stamped with the same ts
dgp_v1_semantics.option_field_definitions: volume cumulative daily; open_interest a level; oi_change unpopulated; implied_volatility null
dgp_v1_semantics.storage_format: one parquet file per poll under YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM.parquet

data_version_compatibility.rule: each forward-collected day must pass the per-day quality screen AND be certified dgp-v1 before inclusion in EXP034-C
data_version_compatibility.invalidation_criteria: a collector or provider change does not automatically disqualify forward data; but if it alters information timing, field meaning, or feature observability, affected days become dgp-v2 and CANNOT be pooled into EXP034-C -- they require a separately numbered experiment
data_version_compatibility.decision_timing: the compatibility decision for every forward day is made BEFORE any EXP034-C model output is inspected
data_version_compatibility.stated_tradeoff: the pre-stamped timestamp and the far-expiry quote-newer-than-spot ordering are arguably defects; repairing either starts dgp-v2 and resets the EXP034-C clock, since pre- and post-fix days cannot be pooled. Fixing the collector is therefore a deliberate decision to delay EXP034-C.

excluded_trading_days.2026-06-26: spot constant (std=0) across all 127 snapshots; root cause = AngelOneProvider.get_spot() daily-close fallback when _live_index_ltp() returns None

per_day_quality_screen.note: applied identically in EXP034-A and EXP034-C

data.oi_change_column: unusable (0 percent nonzero on every day); OI change derived by differencing open_interest per (strike, option_type)

iv.handling: train-fitted median imputation plus iv_available indicator; never silent full-sample imputation

intra_poll_timing.mechanism: one ts stamped before any network call; quotes fetched before spot; get_spot cached 30s; next expiry reuses the cached spot
intra_poll_timing.near_expiry_quotes_vs_spot: quotes older than spot -- safe, biases against finding chain value
intra_poll_timing.next_expiry_quotes_vs_spot: quotes newer than spot -- unsafe look-ahead channel
mitigations: label window opens at t+1 (next valid snapshot)

t_plus_1_definition.rule: t+1 is the NEXT CHRONOLOGICALLY AVAILABLE VALID near-expiry snapshot after t
t_plus_1_definition.missing_intervals: if one or more expected polling intervals are missing, the next available valid snapshot is used
t_plus_1_definition.guarantee: the feature snapshot at t is strictly in the past relative to the prediction window
t_plus_1_definition.diagnostic_reporting: distribution of elapsed_seconds_t_to_t1 reported per fold

secondary.note: T3 is a coarsening of T2 and is deliberately excluded from the primary family

exclusions: label window crossing 15:29 -> observation dropped, never truncated
label window containing any gap > 300 s -> dropped

model_matrices.nesting_required: MODEL_1 subset of MODEL_2 subset of MODEL_3 -- Clark-West validity depends on it

estimator.lightgbm_rule: robustness check only; can NEVER convert a primary ridge null into a positive finding; a ridge null may not trigger a nonlinear-model switch inside this experiment
estimator.alpha_selection: chronological inner split inside the training window only -- inner-train = first 80 percent of training days, inner-validation = last 20 percent; refit on the full training window at the selected alpha
estimator.alpha_prohibition: the OOS test block is never used to select alpha and never influences any fitted parameter

preprocessing_discipline.rule: all preprocessing parameters are fit exclusively on the training portion of each walk-forward fold
prohibited: any statistic computed on validation, test, future or full-sample data
per_fold_order: 1. fit preprocessing on training observations only
3. apply the frozen transformation to the corresponding OOS observations
4. fit the estimator using only transformed training data
5. generate predictions on transformed OOS data without refitting

feature_registry.count_reconciliation_note: REV-1 prose claimed 14 by bundling two distinct IV-skew quantities under one label while its JSON enumerated 15. Every entry was audited for duplication, derivation, or metadata status before locking: none is a duplicate and none is derived from another. F12 (same-strike put-call IV spread) and F13 (cross-strike smile slope) measure different things. The correct universe is 15.
feature_registry.notation: dv_X(k,t) = max(0, vol_cum_X(k,t) - vol_cum_X(k,t-1)); doi_X(k,t) = oi_X(k,t) - oi_X(k,t-1); mid_X(k,t) = (bid+ask)/2 if both positive else last_price; k is the relative strike level; S(t) = ATM straddle mid

features.exact_formula: (sum_{k in -1,0,1} dv_CE(k,t) - sum dv_PE(k,t)) / (sum dv_CE + sum dv_PE + eps)
TV(t) / (mean_{j=1..5} TV(t-j) + eps) - 1, TV(t) = sum_{k in -2..2} (dv_CE + dv_PE)
features.missing_value_rule: drop observation if fewer than 6 prior snapshots that day

features.normalization: mu,sigma over the same 30-min bucket on PRIOR DAYS ONLY, expanding, min 5 prior days
features.missing_value_rule: drop observation if fewer than 5 prior days available

features.exact_formula: (sum_{k in -2..2} doi_CE(k,t) - sum doi_PE(k,t)) / (sum |doi_CE| + sum |doi_PE| + eps)
sum_{k in -1,0,1} (oi_CE + oi_PE) / sum_{all strikes} (oi_CE + oi_PE)
(S_star(t) - S_star(t-1)) / 50, S_star = strike maximizing oi_CE + oi_PE over all collected strikes
PCR(t) - PCR(t-1), PCR = sum_all oi_PE / sum_all oi_CE
features.missing_value_rule: drop observation if t-1 absent or denominator is 0

features.exact_formula: r_CE - r_PE, r_X = mid_X(0,t)/mid_X(0,t-1) - 1, FIXED-STRIKE: the strike that is ATM at t evaluated at both t and t-1
features.missing_value_rule: train-fitted median imputation if that strike is absent at t-1

features.exact_formula: S(t)/S(t-1) - 1, S(t) = mid_CE(0,t) + mid_PE(0,t), same fixed-strike rule
features.missing_value_rule: train-fitted median imputation if absent at t-1

features.exact_formula: mean of iv_CE(0,t), iv_PE(0,t) over those that solve

features.disclosed_weakness: put-call parity implies this is small and partly an artifact of the fixed r=0.065/q=0.012 forward assumption; retained because removing a feature pre-result on a judgement call would still alter the preregistered universe

features.exact_formula: (K_star_CE(t) - spot(t)) / (S(t) + eps), K_star_CE = max-oi_CE strike above spot
features.normalization: normalized by ATM straddle implied move
features.missing_value_rule: drop observation if no strike above spot

features.exact_formula: (spot(t) - K_star_PE(t)) / (S(t) + eps), K_star_PE = max-oi_PE strike below spot
features.normalization: normalized by ATM straddle implied move
features.missing_value_rule: drop observation if no strike below spot

auxiliary_indicators.exact_formula: 1 if F10-F13 all solved at t else 0

walk_forward.purge: drop training observations whose label window overlaps the test block
walk_forward.embargo_snapshots: h (on top of the structural t+1 offset)
walk_forward.reporting: per fold and per trading day, never pooled only
walk_forward.note: generate_windows() is calendar-day based; exp033 established ~0.72 trading days per calendar day. exp034 does fold arithmetic in trading-day space directly.

evaluation.diebold_mariano: NOT USED -- invalid for nested models under the null
evaluation.primary_inference: stationary block bootstrap over whole trading days (analytics.data_snooping.stationary_bootstrap_indices)
evaluation.no_gap_variant_rule: STRICTLY DIAGNOSTIC -- can only invalidate a positive finding, never create or rescue one
evaluation.new_code_required: Clark-West module (stat_tests.py has no DM/CW today) -- exp034-owned

multiple_testing.validity_note: BH validity rests on positive regression dependence among correlated targets; stated, not assumed silently
multiple_testing.m1_only_rule: beating MODEL_1 but not MODEL_2 is NOT primary evidence of incremental option-chain information and may not be reported as such
multiple_testing.secondary_rule: corrected separately; can never establish a primary claim
multiple_testing.ablations_and_importance: run ONLY if a primary hypothesis succeeds, and only within the same OOS folds

preflight_consistency_check.requirement: must run before any execution and exit non-zero on any mismatch, aborting the experiment
checks: chain feature count == 15 and every feature ID F01-F15 present exactly once
realized model matrix column counts == MODEL_1 30 / MODEL_2 35 / MODEL_3 51 after excluding declared metadata columns
MODEL_1 subset of MODEL_2 subset of MODEL_3 verified on the built matrices
primary target count == 4 and target IDs match
ablation group membership matches the registry and partitions F01-F15
audit columns present: feature_timestamp, prediction_start_timestamp, prediction_end_timestamp, elapsed_seconds_t_to_t1
config file hash matches the value recorded at lock time
preflight_consistency_check.rationale: mirrors the EXP033 freeze tooling, which exists precisely to catch the class of drift that produced the 14-vs-15 discrepancy in REV-1
preflight_consistency_check.implementation_status: specified here; to be implemented after preregistration approval

power.procedure: minimum detectable effect computed from the initial 30-day training block only, recorded in a locked addendum BEFORE any OOS fold is scored
power.pre_declared: T1 (signed return) is very likely UNDERPOWERED; T2 (magnitude) is where a genuine positive is plausible
power.interpretation_rule: 'no evidence of incremental information' and 'evidence of no incremental information' are different conclusions and must never be conflated; at this sample size a T1 null means the former. A null may be reported as evidence of absence only if the pre-computed minimum detectable effect is SMALLER than a meaningful effect size, which is not expected to hold for T1.
power.stated_confound: IV and VIX may largely re-encode recent realized vol; this is why MODEL_3 vs MODEL_2 is primary

success_criteria_exp034A_all_must_hold: mean delta OOS-R2 (MODEL_3 - MODEL_2) > 0 pooled across the OOS period
Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 under the day-block bootstrap
survives BH-FDR at q=0.10 across the 4 primary hypotheses
effect holds under the locked t+1 timing definition and is not dependent on the diagnostic no-gap variant
success_verdict_exp034A: EXPLORATORY EVIDENCE OF INCREMENTAL INFORMATION -- authorizes only running EXP034-C; not strategy work, paper trading, or capital
confirmation_rule: a finding is CONFIRMED only if EXP034-A's five criteria hold AND EXP034-C independently reproduces the SAME SIGN of improvement on the forward-only sample, same target, same locked pipeline. Any other EXP034-C outcome leaves the finding exploratory.
failure_criteria_any_triggers: effect depends on the no-gap diagnostic
failure_verdict: NO EXPLORATORY EVIDENCE OF INCREMENTAL INFORMATION
inconclusive_band: point estimate positive but CI spans zero AND estimate below the pre-computed minimum detectable effect -> INCONCLUSIVE - UNDERPOWERED, never reported as evidence of absence
negative_result_rule: a negative result is an acceptable and expected outcome; no search continues after it
anti_snooping_guards: no threshold, feature, target, horizon or model added, removed or tuned after the first OOS fold is scored
a weak result is never grounds for adding features
a losing target is never dropped; all four primaries reported
the LightGBM check cannot rescue a ridge null, and a ridge null may not trigger a nonlinear-model switch inside this experiment
feature importance only after a primary success, only OOS
any genuinely new idea arising during the run belongs to EXP035+

scope.costs: none -- information study, not a strategy

known_limitations: approximately 2-minute irregular sampling (131-133s); t+1 is the next valid snapshot, not a nominal 2-minute offset
58 usable days; single calm regime (VIX 10.4-15.1), no stress period
derived OI changes and derived IV rather than stored
serial correlation within trading days and overlapping future labels
ATM strike rolls intraday, causing relative-strike feature discontinuity (atm_rolled indicator included; F08-F11 use a fixed-strike rule)
expiry vs non-expiry regime differences (12 of 58 days) -- indicator plus pre-registered stratified secondary, never a tuning knob
third pass over the same 59 days -- handled by the sample_reuse decision
F12 is expected to be small and partly an artifact of the fixed forward assumption
predictive information is not tradability; economic significance deferred to EXP035+
